## How the site is organised

The site uses three practical resource types: guidance, training and materials. Subtypes such as decision tools, case studies, literature notes and Cambridge links are handled with tags.

## Transparency rules

- Draft and reviewed content are visibly distinct.
- Every resource carries explicit metadata.
- Contributions enter through GitHub issues so suggestions remain traceable.
- Literature notes should explain relevance, not just store citations.
